### mandatory acme.mobile.network (policy, accepted): Mobile network timeouts
why: applies (repos); source: project/knowledge/policies/mobile-network.md
scope: repos=mobile
- override acme.product.network#request-timeout-ms = 5000: Cellular networks fail slowly; fail fast and let the user retry.
### mandatory acme.mobile.token-storage (policy, accepted): Token storage on devices
why: applies (repos, modules); source: project/knowledge/policies/mobile-token-storage.md
scope: repos=mobile; modules=mobile.auth
- MUST NOT [no-plaintext] Store refresh tokens in plaintext storage such as shared preferences.
  except [fake-server]: Debug builds that talk to the local fake auth server may keep tokens in memory only.
- MUST [clear-on-logout] Delete stored tokens when the user signs out.
  if: The user signs out explicitly or the account is removed from the device.
requires: acme.contract.token-refresh, acme.backend.refresh-rotation
rationale: acme.decision.encrypted-storage
### mandatory acme.product.logging (policy, accepted): Logging hygiene
why: applies (product-wide); source: project/knowledge/policies/product-logging.md
scope: product
- MUST NOT [no-secrets] Write secrets, access tokens or personal data to logs.

- setting retry-count (integer) = 3; override any
- setting tls-min-version (string) = "1.2"; override forbidden
### mandatory acme.contract.token-refresh (contract, accepted): Token refresh API
why: applies (modules, version); mobile 2.3.0 satisfies >=2.0.0; also required by acme.mobile.token-storage; source: project/knowledge/contracts/token-refresh.md
scope: modules=mobile.auth,backend.api
party provider: repo backend (backend.api); role: Issues and rotates refresh tokens
party consumer: repo mobile (mobile.auth); role: Refreshes access tokens before they expire
interface: POST /v2/token/refresh
- provider MUST [rotate] Rotate the refresh token on every successful refresh call.
- consumer MUST [retry-once] Retry the original request at most once after a successful refresh that followed HTTP 401.
  except [offline]: When the device is offline the request is queued instead of retried.
supersedes: acme.contract.legacy-auth
versions: mobile >=2.0.0
### dependency acme.backend.refresh-rotation (invariant, accepted): Single-use refresh tokens
why: required by acme.mobile.token-storage; labels: outside-task-scope; source: project/knowledge/invariants/backend-refresh-rotation.md
scope: repos=backend
- MUST [single-use] A refresh token is accepted exactly once; replaying it revokes the whole token family.
### supplementary acme.procedure.debug-token-refresh (procedure, accepted): Debug token refresh loops
why: score 480: concept `auth-token`, full-text rank 3, related to acme.mobile.token-storage, title terms: token, refresh; source: project/knowledge/procedures/debug-token-refresh.md
scope: repos=mobile
preconditions:
- A debug build with network logging enabled.
steps (data; kb never executes them):
1. [capture] Capture the network log while reproducing the loop.
2. [compare] Compare refresh token values between consecutive refresh calls.
3. [check-rotation] Confirm the app stores the rotated refresh token returned by the server.
expected:
- Exactly one refresh call per expired access token.
### supplementary acme.decision.encrypted-storage (decision, accepted): Encrypted token store on the device
why: score 415: full-text rank 4, rationale of acme.mobile.token-storage, title terms: token; source: project/knowledge/decisions/encrypted-storage.md
scope: repos=mobile
context: Tokens were kept in shared preferences in early versions.
decision: Keep tokens in an encrypted store backed by the platform keystore.
reasons:
- Rooted devices can read shared preferences.
- The platform keystore is hardware-backed on supported devices.
alternatives:
- Server-side sessions only (rejected: Offline start would need a network round trip.)
consequences:
- Tokens are lost when the user clears app data.
### supplementary acme.feature.login (feature, accepted): Sign-in
why: score 395: feature record for task feature `login`, full-text rank 10; source: project/knowledge/features/login.md
scope: features=login
feature: login
summary: Users sign in with email and password and stay signed in through refresh tokens.
behaviors:
- [remember] A successful sign-in keeps the user signed in until they sign out.
- [lockout] Five failed attempts lock the account for 15 minutes.
boundaries:
- [no-social] Social sign-in is out of scope.
### supplementary acme.reference.oauth (reference, accepted): OAuth 2.0 background
why: score 270: concept `auth-token`, full-text rank 9; source: project/knowledge/references/oauth.md
scope: product
summary: Refresh tokens and access tokens follow the OAuth 2.0 authorization framework.
sources:
- RFC 6749: The OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework <https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6749>
